name: Lily in Hawaii
source: Geoff and Lily had decided to take a break from their work and take a "romantic" holiday to the island of Hawaii for their anniversary, in hopes of reigniting the spark that they once had for each other.
translation: 杰夫和莉莉决定暂时放下工作，去夏威夷大岛度过一个“浪漫”的假期来庆祝结婚纪念日，希望能够重新点燃彼此曾经的火花。
